answer.summary: A peer-reviewed controlled experiment from 2022 to 2024 is needed that evaluates agent memory retention under token constraints with explicit baseline reporting and measurable state evolution metrics.
answer.content: The investigation must identify a single primary-source paper that reports a controlled experiment involving agent memory with token-constrained conditions, observable memory state changes, and quantitative baseline comparisons to validate performance under shared, bounded conditions. Evidence must directly support the presence of measurable memory retention or state evolution in response to input constraints. No implementation or system design is permitted in this phase.
